data.found_evidence: uv run python -c "from ddflow.services.gates import baseline_red as B; print(B.FT)" printed a function when FT was imported with `from ..ci import failure_text as FT`
data.summary: ddflow/services/ci/__init__.py maps the lazy name failure_text to services.flakes.failure_text (a function); `from ddflow.services.ci import failure_text` returns that function, not the module ddflow/services/ci/failure_text.py that GM-ci-path-normalise adds. Importers must use `from ddflow.services.ci.failure_text import ...`. Rename one of them.
data.title: ci package lazy attribute failure_text shadows a failure_text submodule

data.body:
Fixes bug B663d174cba: ddflow/services/ci/__init__.py maps the lazy name failure_text to services.flakes.failure_text (a function); `from ddflow.services.ci import failure_text` returns that function, not the module ddflow/services/ci/failure_text.py that GM-ci-path-normalise adds. Importers must use `from ddflow.services.ci.failure_text import ...`. Rename one of them. Found on GM-ci-path-normalise.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B663d174cba --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B663d174cba --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B663d174cba: ci package lazy attribute failure_text shadows a failure_text submodule

data.found_evidence: ddflow review GM-ci-path-normalise --gate rubber_duck,critic --force --reason x --approval request -> ddflow: error: unrecognized arguments: --approval request
data.summary: After [review].max_rounds (6) rounds the refusal says to ask the operator for `ddflow review ... --force --reason`, but `ddflow review` accepts no --approval request (argparse error), so an agent cannot file the operator approval the way gate skip and merge can. Also a round is charged when the reviewer repeats findings already triaged as not applicable (docs row for a task with no knob), so a six-round budget is spent on repeats.
data.title: review budget spent leaves an agent no approval route: ddflow review has no --approval flag

data.body:
Fixes bug B6cbaeebc00: After [review].max_rounds (6) rounds the refusal says to ask the operator for `ddflow review ... --force --reason`, but `ddflow review` accepts no --approval request (argparse error), so an agent cannot file the operator approval the way gate skip and merge can. Also a round is charged when the reviewer repeats findings already triaged as not applicable (docs row for a task with no knob), so a six-round budget is spent on repeats. Found on GM-ci-path-normalise.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B6cbaeebc00 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B6cbaeebc00 --regression-test <test>` first).

Not attached, they match nothing in the tree: ddflow/services/ci/failure_text.py, tests/test_ci_failure_text_paths.py.
